about: The agent roster, fixed now so later phases add files and never rename. Read by
scripts/validate_agent_contracts.py, so all four agree on who exists.
Phase 1 agents have a file under .claude/agents/. Phase 2+ agents are listed so the
names are reserved; the contract validator reports them as NOTE, not as failures.
`delivery: true` marks the one agent allowed to run scripts/docs_edit.py. The hook
that enforces it (require-delivery-agent.py) hardcodes the same name on purpose, and
the guardrail self-test checks the two still agree.

orchestrator.lane: dispatch, reality-checker, deviation memos, Needs Your Input

agents.name: REED
agents.specialty: Action Register: topic vs commitment, owner and date resolution, history, retrieval

agents.name: PAGE
agents.specialty: Running Docs: read structure, pick the section, write the edit proposal

agents.name: WREN
agents.specialty: Delivery: the only agent that runs docs_edit.py; reads every write back

agents.name: HUGO
agents.specialty: Unblocking: tokens, 4xx, stale revisions, a gate that looks wrong

agents.name: LARK
agents.specialty: Daily brief, reply control, meeting prep (also Phase 7)
